blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit has flagged the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for documentation deficiencies in implementing its relief operations that involved funds worth almost P168 million. This was contained in a 273-page COA report on the 2025 Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund, which was submitted to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro last August 28. Teodoro is serving as concurrent chairman of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council. According to the audit report, auditors found inconsistencies between situational reports (sitreps) from the agencies or local government units concerned and OVP’s own situational reports, amounting to ₱19.67 million.
